author: _Bacon69
body:
Well this was the first server i played ever on minecraft 3 or 4 years ago and i loved it it had: Skywars But a special type that no other server had it was a huge map with 3 teams it was my favorite game i was about to donate and i went on and skywars was gone i was going to get Diamond but i changed my mind
my favorite thing about this was the levels system which was gone one day
You did one good thing (Get rid of the G vs G game)
you also made a parkour mini game (that you got rid of) also the hub has gone downhill
Go back to how it used to be you will have 1K people like you used to Please :D

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
A lot of people still want the levels to come back, maybe they will, maybe they won't.
We still have a parkour, and it's pretty hard to defeat since it's so long.
We can't just go back to how it use to be, that would literally take months. We have new administrators (again) and they're planning on doing some serious advertising which could boost the player count quite a bit. Also, having 1k people wasn't really that much of a good thing since 900 of them would be salty inconsiderate jerks.
In my opinion the old hubs WERE much better, but it's probably just my nostalgia kicking in.

I agree with bringing sky wars back and raising he player count, but not quite the rest. :p

I would love to bring Skywars back but I always worry that it'll bomb.
I mean, everyone wanted Survival games back, it was probably one of (if not the) most hyped feature in the last major update.

I just don't want that to happen to Skywars, it'll just be weeks/months of work going up in smoke.
